Walk to the- actually stand next to the brown side table next to that red couch. Don't pass the couch. Take a sharp left and you'll see an opening into, probably, a foyer. Go straight past the stairs, past the couch and go stand in front of the TV in the left corner of the room. You'll actually be standing right in front of the double doors, next to the TV. This is your final destination.
